blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.
blocks.zh: 长视线剂必须从相接的轨迹中学习各种能力。 更新共同的参数以学习新的能力可能会降低以前获得的参数,从而造成灾难性的遗忘。 随着轨迹的发展,不同阶段可能需要不同的能力,然而传统的联合培训和静态适配器合并在整个执行过程中保持固定参数配置. 我们引入了WeAct(Weight-level Internal Action),它通过一个被冷冻的骨干对独立能力特定的LORA适配器进行培训,并在代理器的动作空间中添加适配器的选择. 这些内部行动使用该模型的本土工具调用界面,在共享的上下文中进行需求能力构成. 在8个深度研究基准中,WeAct的Quen3-32B与完全微调对应方相比提高了平均精确度6.2%,尽管使用计算较少,与最强的静态LORA-merging方法相比提高了27.5%。 WeAct还支持模块化的持续适应,方法是增加一个新的代码计算适配器来扩展代理的能力并更新现有的写适配器来提高报告质量. 两项更新都使主干和其他适配器保持不变,支持在物剂中进行模块化的持续适应.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Long-horizon agents plan and invoke tools, connect evidence across sources and reasoning steps, and retrieve and synthesize web information over many turns. The required capabilities vary across stages and must adapt as domains, tools, and output requirements evolve. Fine-tuning or reinforcement learning ( Li et al., 2026a ; Hu et al., 2025 ) typically optimize these capabilities in shared parameters: misaligned capability gradients can impair joint learning ( Li et al., 2026b ) , and later updates can erode earlier gains ( Thede et al., 2026 ) . Prompt-level skills ( Ni et al., 2026 ) offer adaptation without changing weights, but their instructions consume context when loaded for execution.
blocks.zh: 长视特工计划并援引工具,将各种来源和推理步骤之间的证据联系起来,并在多个转弯处检索和合成网络信息. 各个阶段所需的能力各不相同,必须随着域、工具和产出需求的变化而适应。 微调或强化学习(Li等人,2026a); Hu et al., 2025 ) 通常在共享参数中优化这些能力:错位能力梯度会损害联合学习(Li et al., 2026b),后来的更新会侵蚀更早的成果(Thede et al., 2026 ). 即时级技能(Ni等人,2026年)提供不改变重量的适应,但其指令在加载执行时会消耗上下文.

blocks.en: Separate LoRA adapters isolate capability parameters, but their composition adds deployment requirements. MoLE ( Wu et al., 2024 ) and LD-MoLE ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) mix expert outputs through layerwise gates, requiring support for composition inside the forward pass. Static merging, from conflict reduction in TIES ( Yadav et al., 2023 ) to alignment in KnOTS ( Stoica et al., 2025 ) , combines updates before deployment. These methods improve composition, but use fixed merged weights across stages, which may weaken the specialization needed at each stage. Our key idea is to make independently maintained capabilities callable as agent actions. Extending ReAct’s external actions ( Yao et al., 2023 ) , we use internal actions to activate learned weights with on-demand flexibility.
blocks.zh: 单独的LORA适配器隔离能力参数,但其组成增加了部署要求. MOLE(Wu等人,2024年)和LD-MOLE(Zhuang等人,2026年)通过分层门将专家输出混合,需要支持前传内部的构成. 静态合并,从减少TIES(Yadav等人,2023年)中的冲突到KnOTS(Stoica等人,2025年)中的调整,在部署前合并更新。 这些方法改善组成,但采用不同阶段的固定合并权重,这可能会削弱每个阶段所需的专业化. 我们的主要想法是将独立维持的能力称为代理人行动。 推广ReAct的外部行动(Yao等人,2023年),我们利用内部行动,以需求的灵活性激活所学的权重。

blocks.en: We introduce WeAct ( We ight-level Internal Act ions; Figure 1 ), a general method for capability composition in tool-using agents, to learn heterogeneous capabilities for long-horizon tasks while preserving prior gains and invoking the capability needed at each stage. Each capability LoRA is trained over a frozen backbone on its own stages and exit actions, using preceding interactions as context. It learns to continue prior work, reason, call tools, and hand back control. At inference, our load_lora and offload_lora tools activate and release one adapter through the native tool-calling interface, with their descriptions and control exchanges recorded in context. The selected weights govern subsequent reasoning and tool use within the same history. WeAct -soft chooses capabilities from this history; WeAct -hard prescribes loading every adapter in the workflow for reliable invocation. Both use the same interface without a separately trained router. Adding or refreshing a capability updates only its adapter.

blocks.en: Experiments on Qwen3-32B test capability separation during learning and execution. Controlled diagnostics show that extra shared capacity does not prevent lost gains and that tested static merges reduce specialists’ target-text fit (Section 3 ). Across eight deep-research benchmarks, WeAct -hard reaches 45.47% average accuracy, a 6.2% relative improvement over Full SFT, and both variants outperform all tested static merges on every benchmark (Section 4.2 ). WeAct uses fewer trainable parameters and less nominal training compute than Full SFT while retaining the evaluated general capabilities. Code insertion expands the library with stable performance, and Writing refresh improves report quality on ResearchQA and DeepResearchBench (Section 4.5 ). These results suggest potential for modular continual adaptation through capability expansion and local refinement.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We present WeAct for independent capability training and coordinated invocation via native tools in a shared history. • We distinguish learning interference from static fusion mismatch, motivating capability-aligned training and intact adapter selection. • We demonstrate improved deep-research performance alongside capability insertion and local refinement, supporting continual learning through modular expansion and updates.

blocks.en: Figure 2 connects training and inference. During training, stage-specific assistant targets and exit calls supervise independent adapters over retained execution context. We group deep-research stages into planning, evidence search and verification, and writing, yielding LoRA-plan , LoRA-search , and LoRA-write . These stages separate deciding what to do next, acquiring and checking external evidence, and synthesizing the answer. In exploratory annotation, finer splits were unstable: separating retrieval from verification or adding a state-recap stage let small rule changes move the same evidence operation between labels, and folding retrieval into planning made Plan absorb evidence-gathering steps (Appendix A.2 ). We therefore keep evidence operations together in LoRA-search . During inference, external tools supply observations and internal actions select weights, with both exchanges extending the shared history. WeAct-hard prescribes adapter invocation for reliable use; WeAct-soft selects capabilities according to the evolving task state in that history.

blocks.en: 3 Understanding Capability Separation
blocks.zh: 3 理解能力分离

blocks.en: Learning heterogeneous capabilities through shared parameters, can erode earlier gains. Training separate LoRAs isolates their updates, but static fusion can alter each specialist’s effects during execution. We use controlled retention and fusion diagnostics to examine these two sources of interference and motivate WeAct ’s capability-aligned parameter partitioning during learning and separate adapter selection during execution.
blocks.zh: 通过共同的参数学习各种能力,可能会侵蚀早先的成果。 单独训练LORAS会隔离其更新,但静态聚变可以在执行过程中改变每个专家的效果. 我们使用受控的保留和聚变诊断来检查这两种干扰源,并激励WeAct在学习过程中与能力匹配的参数分割,以及在执行过程中对适配器进行单独选择。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: We evaluate WeAct on eight deep-research benchmarks, then analyze evidence use in execution traces and training and inference efficiency. We also test capability insertion and local updates to assess modular continual adaptation.

blocks.en: Model and adapters. Weight-adaptation experiments start from Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) : LoRA methods freeze the backbone; Full SFT updates it. Single LoRA uses rank 128, matching the combined parameter count of the three separately trained adapters; static merges use rank 64. Only capability expansion uses LoRA-code . blocks.en: 4.4 Training and Inference Efficiency

Across unequal capability segments, 2.06 × \times token exposure at 0.95 × \times per-token compute yields 1.96 × \times total compute relative to Single LoRA with matched total trainable parameters (Appendix B.1 ). These results support efficient training of independent capability adapters.

blocks.en: 4.5 Modular Continual Adaptation
blocks.zh: 4.5 模块连续适应

blocks.en: We assess catastrophic forgetting and modular continual adaptation: expanding and refining the library while retaining existing capabilities. We first evaluate general-capability retention with external tools disabled (Appendix H ), then examine Code insertion and a local Writing refresh.
blocks.zh: 我们评估灾难性的遗忘和模块化的持续适应:扩大和完善图书馆,同时保留现有能力。 我们首先用已禁用的外部工具(Appendix H)来评价一般能力保留,然后检查代码插入和本地写入更新。

blocks.en: 4.5.2 Adapting to Evolving Writing Tasks
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 适应不断变化的写作任务

blocks.en: We test whether updating a single capability improves system-level report quality while preserving the rest of the library’s parameters. We continue training the existing LoRA-write adapter on trajectories synthesized in our harness from the OpenScholar ( Asai et al., 2026 ) subset of DR Tulu ( Shao et al., 2026 ) SFT data, replacing it with LoRA-write++ . The base stays frozen, Plan and Search remain bitwise unchanged, and no historical data are replayed.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en: Deep-Research Agent Training. WebSailor-V2 and Tongyi DeepResearch improve agent training through synthetic data and post-training ( Li et al., 2026a ; Tongyi DeepResearch Team et al., 2026 ) . Step-DeepResearch and MiroThinker further organize learning around atomic capabilities ( Hu et al., 2025 ; MiroMind Team et al., 2026 ) . These methods share parameters across capabilities, coupling subsequent updates. Separating trainable parameters allows local refinement without updating the remaining library; WeAct realizes this organization as callable adapters over a frozen backbone.
blocks.zh: 深研代理培训. WebSailor-V2和Tongyi深海研究通过合成数据和后培训改进剂剂培训(Li等人,2026a;Tongyi深海研究) Team等人,2026年). Step-DeepResearch和MiroThinker进一步组织围绕原子能力的学习(Hu等人,2025年;MiroMind Team等人,2026年)。 这些方法在各种能力之间共享参数,使随后的更新相配合. 分离可训练参数可以进行局部修饰,而不更新剩余库; WeAct认识到这个组织是一个冷冻主干线上的可调适器.

blocks.en: Multi-Agent Orchestration. ManuSearch delegates planning, search, and reading to specialized agents; Chain of Agents distributes long contexts across workers ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Their handoffs require intermediate messages and a manager to integrate the workers’ outputs. In WeAct , moving control between capability weights on a shared backbone offers another form of specialization: each selected policy continues from the same interaction history.
blocks.zh: 多代理乐团. ManuSearch代表计划、搜索和阅读给专门人员; 代理链在工人之间分布长处(黄等人,2025年;张等人,2024年)。 它们的发放需要中间信息,需要一名管理人员来整合工人的产出。 在 WeAct 中,在共享骨干上的能力权重之间的移动控制提供了另一种专业化形式:每个选定的政策都从同一个互动历史中延续.

blocks.en: Multi-LoRA Composition and Routing. Early work such as LoRAHub and MoLE established reusable adapter composition ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024 ) . LD-MoLE learns token-dependent layerwise gates ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) ; LoGo selects and merges adapters per input without additional training ( Lee et al., 2026 ) . These methods focus on combining experts for task inputs rather than managing capability handoffs during an evolving agent trajectory. Adaptive Minds keeps the base model in control when calling adapters as tools ( Shekar and Krishnan, 2026 ) , whereas WeAct transfers control to the selected adapter. Macaron-V1 selects specialists per user turn ( Mind Lab et al., 2026 ) . Building on these approaches, WeAct couples independent capability learning with explicit handoffs within an agent trajectory. Selected adapters control reasoning and external tool use from shared history until offloading.
blocks.zh: 多种乐谱 组成与游击. LoRAHub和MOLE等早期工作确立了可重复使用的适配器构成(黄等人,2024年;吴等人,2024年). LD-MOLE学习了依赖象征的层隔门( Zhu等人,2026年);LoGo在不经过额外培训的情况下,每投入选择和合并适配器(李等人,2026年). 这些方法侧重于将专家结合起来,以获得任务投入,而不是在不断变化的代理轨迹中管理能力移交。 在调用适配器作为工具时(Shekar and Krishnan, 2026),适配的Minds保持了基本模型的控制,而WeAct则将控制转移给选定的适配器. Macaron-V1每个用户回合选择专家(Mind Lab等人,2026年). 在这些方法的基础上,我们行动社与独立的能力学习结合,在物剂轨迹中明确交割。 选择适配器控制推理和外部工具使用,从共享历史到卸载.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Research on preserving specialization spans the frozen columns of early Progressive Neural Networks ( Rusu et al., 2016 ) and the separate reasoning and tool-use LoRAs of recent DART ( Li et al., 2026b ) . Our capacity-matched and random-partition controls show that capability alignment matters beyond capacity; fixed-library diagnostics reveal local fusion mismatch even without rank compression (Section 3 ). These results distinguish preserving learned parameters from preserving their functional effects during composition. Together with LoRA memory analysis ( Back et al., 2026 ) , they support aligning modules with independent update needs and selecting intact adapters as execution demands. Internal actions make this principle operational: newly trained LoRAs can enter an existing agent through the same interface. This suggests modular continual learning, with retention within updated modules remaining open.
blocks.zh: 关于保持专业化的研究跨越了早期进化神经网络的冷冻柱(Rusu等人,2016年)和最近的DART(Li等人,2026年b)的单独推理和工具使用LORAS. 我们的能力匹配和随机分区控制显示,能力对齐问题超出能力范围;即使没有排位压缩,固定图书馆诊断也显示局部聚变不匹配(第3节)。 这些结果区分了保留学到的参数和在组成过程中保留其功能效应. 它们与LORA内存分析(Back et al., 2026)一起,支持将模块与独立更新需求对齐,并选择完好无损的适配器作为执行需求. 内部行动使这一原则可以操作:新训练的LORA可以通过同一接口进入现有的代理. 这表明模块不断学习,更新模块内保留的内容仍然开放。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We presented WeAct , which learns heterogeneous capabilities in independent LoRAs over a frozen backbone and switches active weights through internal actions within a shared agent trajectory. Controlled diagnostics support capability-aligned training and runtime selection for preserving specialization. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, WeAct improves average accuracy over Full SFT with lower nominal training compute. Code insertion expands the library with stable performance, and Writing refresh improves report quality. These results support independently learning agent capabilities and switching between them during execution, with potential for modular continual learning.
blocks.zh: 我们提出 WeAct, 它学习了独立LORAs在冷冻骨干上的不同能力, 并通过共享代理轨迹的内部行动切换主动权重。 受控制的诊断支持能力匹配培训和为保持专业化而选择运行时间。 在8项深入研究基准中,WeAct比Full SFT提高平均准确度,并降低名义培训计算。 代码插入可以以稳定的性能扩展库,写入刷新可以提高报告质量. 这些成果支持独立学习代理能力,并在执行期间相互转换,有可能进行模块化的持续学习。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: Extending WeAct to sustained continual learning raises open questions about routing capacity and capability boundaries. It remains unclear how many adapters the agent can reliably distinguish and invoke as the library grows, and how well it can sustain longer sequences of internal actions. Repeated module insertion or refinement may also change capability selection, even when the rest of the library remains fixed. When task boundaries are unclear, general abilities such as reasoning may be needed across multiple stages, making it difficult to define separate LoRA modules and determine when each should be active. Whether incremental adapter expansion can improve these abilities while preserving performance on existing tasks remains an open question.
blocks.zh: 将《我们法案》扩大到持续不断学习,提出了关于路线能力和能力界限的未决问题。 仍然不清楚的是,随着图书馆的发展,代理人能够可靠地区分和引用多少个适配器,以及它能够在多大程度上维持较长的内部行动序列。 重复的模块插入或改进也可能改变能力选择,即使图书馆的其余部分仍然固定不变. 当任务界限不清时,可能需要跨多个阶段的推理等一般能力,因此很难定义单独的LORA模块,也难以确定每个模块应何时活动. 递增适配器的扩展能否提高这些能力,同时保持现有任务的业绩,仍然是一个有待解决的问题。

blocks.zh: 能力标签遵循舞台的目的(第2.2节): 计划设定目标和检索议程; 搜索获取证据,检查来源,并交叉检查索赔; 写入综合了支持的答案. 跨度可能包括几个助手/工具转弯. MiroVerse导出将第一次搜索之前的规划与随后的搜索交互和最终的答案合成分开. 为了不断修改,代码扩展从MiroVerse-MegaScience提取了3,413个代码计算样本,200个用于验证; 写入来自OpenScholar子集DR-Tulu SFT数据的1 000个续作样本(Asai等人,2026年;Shao等人,2026年)。 这些维护公司与最初三个适配器的数据是分开的。

blocks.en: Train–test overlap. MiroVerse does not document the original splits of its sources, so we check overlap at the task level. We compare the task text of all 6,962 training trajectories with every evaluation question of the eight benchmarks. No evaluation question appears verbatim after normalization. A lexical screen flags questions with at least half of their IDF-weighted content words in a single training task whose trajectory also contains the gold answer; manual review of the flagged pairs finds overlap only through decomposed sub-agent subtasks. For 63 of the 2,417 MuSiQue questions (2.6%), the answer-bearing sub-question appears with the same answer as a training subtask, and 19 of these restate the full question with the bridge entity resolved. One WebWalkerQA question and one 2Wiki question show similar overlap; GAIA, Bamboogle, XBench-DS, BrowseComp, and FRAMES show none. Removing the 63 MuSiQue questions lowers each method’s MuSiQue accuracy by 0.04–0.47 points and leaves the ranking unchanged. The screen does not detect paraphrases below its threshold.

MiroVerse不记录其源的原始分割,所以我们在任务层面检查重叠. 我们把所有6 962个培训轨迹的任务案文与八个基准的每一个评价问题进行比较。 在正常化之后,没有逐字列出评价问题。 单项训练任务中至少有一半以色列国防军加权内容字的词汇屏幕标记问题,其轨迹也包含金色答案;对标记对子的人工审查发现,只有通过分解的子代理子任务才能发现重叠。 对于2,417个MuSiQue问题中的63个问题(2.6%),包含答案的子问题与培训子任务出现相同的答案,其中19个问题与桥梁实体解决了全部问题。 一个WebWalkerQA问题和一个2Wiki问题显示类似的重叠;GAIA,Bamboogle, X Bench-DS,浏览器Comp,和FRAMES显示没有. 删除63个 MuSiQue 问题后, 每种方法的 MuSiQue 准确度降低0.04-0.47 点, 排名不变 。 屏幕无法检测其阈值以下的参数。

Recapping known facts and gaps overlapped with ongoing evidence gathering; narrowing recap and broadening verification changed many assignments. Replace recap with Evidence Collection . This category remained ambiguous with Verification : identical lookups could be labeled as gathering details or checking a candidate.
blocks.zh: 精细的标签和相互竞争的定义。 从检索中分离代码 。 优先执行增加代码和减少检索任务。 将吸附物回收到计划或核查中 订正的定义在这些标签之间转移了任务,有时使总数不变。 孤州复论. 查明已知的事实和差距与不断收集的证据重叠;缩小范围并扩大核查范围改变了许多任务。 将摘要改为证据收集。 这一类别与核查仍然含糊不清:同样的检查可以被贴上收集细节或检查候选人的标签。

blocks.en: Granularity and category-specific rules. Sparse labeling left nearly all messages unlabeled. Whole-turn labels recovered coverage; block-level labels also allowed opening plans and tool actions to be separated. Browse-oriented rules increased Verification on MiroVerse but reduced it on DR-Tulu while increasing Plan , indicating policy sensitivity rather than annotation accuracy. Introduce a Math capability. Math received only one span in each larger MiroVerse and DR-Tulu batch, offering little support for a separate module in this corpus.
blocks.zh: 颗粒性和特定类别规则。 Sparse 标签使得几乎所有信件都未加标签 。 全回合标签回收覆盖;块级标签也允许打开计划和工具动作分离. 浏览规则增加了对MiroVerse的核查,但减少了对DR-Tulu的核查,同时增加了Plan,表明政策敏感性而不是注释准确性。 引入数学能力. 在MiroVerse和DR-Tulu的批次中,数学只得到一个跨度,对本体中一个单独的模块几乎没有支持。

blocks.en: Resulting capability design. We retain Plan , Search , Writing , and Code for choosing goals and actions, acquiring and checking external evidence, synthesizing answers, and executing computations. Unify external-evidence operations as Search . Evidence collection, source inspection, and verification share one capability, avoiding adapter assignments based on how a lookup is phrased. The main-table library uses Plan , Search , and Writing ; Code is tested separately through capability insertion. The initial merged Search variant covered fewer tool-call blocks than its predecessor. Structural search candidates and text-anchored boundaries were still needed to recover coverage. These annotation findings motivate the chosen capabilities and segmentation procedure.
blocks.zh: 产生能力设计。 我们保留计划、搜索、写作和代码,用于选择目标和行动、获取和检查外部证据、合成答案和执行计算。 将外部证据操作统一为搜索 。 证据收集、源头检查和核查都具有一种能力,避免根据检索的用语分配适配器。 主表库使用 Plan, Search, and Writing;代码通过能力插入单独测试. 初始合并的Search变体覆盖的工具调用区块少于其前身. 为了恢复覆盖面,仍然需要结构搜索候选人和文字上的界限。 这些注释结论激励了所选择的能力和分割程序。

blocks.en: B.2 Historical Inference Efficiency
blocks.zh: B.2 历史推论效率

blocks.en: Records and timing. This analysis uses the logged runs behind the main results, collected over time on the same server with the same concurrency, harness, and tool conditions; we call them historical runs. The quality–time analysis covers six methods on eight benchmarks. The wall-time ECDFs additionally include ManuSearch, whose BrowseComp logs are unavailable, and use all 37,928 task-level records with valid timing. For each task and attempt, the first run is retry 0 and the final run is the highest retry index. Accuracy uses the final run’s judgment, and cost sums all runs up to it. Figures 5 and 8 pair these times with the accuracy in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 记录和时间。 这一分析使用记录在主要结果后面的运行,这些运行经过一段时间后收集在同一服务器上,具有同样的货币、杠杆和工具条件;我们称之为历史运行。 质量-时间分析包括8个基准的6个方法。 墙上时间的ECDF中还包括ManuSearch, 其浏览器Comp日志不可用,并使用所有37,928任务级别记录,并有有效的时间. 对于每个任务和尝试,第一次运行是重试0,最后运行是最高的重试指数. 准确性用的是最后的判断,费用总额都达到了这一目的。 图5和图8的准确度见表1。

blocks.en: Model-path time is the union of model-call intervals within a run, summed across retries. Task-record wall time spans the logged task start and end and can include post-answer judging, so it measures logged execution time rather than answer-ready latency. The ECDFs include successful, failed, and anomaly-flagged records with valid timing, with one curve per method and benchmark.
blocks.zh: 模式-路径时间是模式调用间隔在一次循环中结合的,在反复重复中归纳. 任务记录的墙壁时间跨过已记录的任务的开始和结束,并可以包括回答后判断,因此它可以衡量记录的执行时间,而不是回答准备的延迟. ECDF包括成功,失败,以及带有有效时间标记的异常记录,每个方法和基准有一个曲线.

blocks.en: Quality–model-path time comparisons. On GAIA, WeAct -soft improves accuracy over Single LoRA from 35.9% to 46.6% while reducing mean model-path time from 774.9 to 364.1 seconds; WeAct -hard reaches 40.8% at 181.0 seconds (Figure 8 ). TIES-R64 has shorter model paths on Multi-hop QA but lower accuracy than both WeAct variants on all eight benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 质量 - 模式 - 路径时间比较 。 在GAIA上,WeAct-soft提高单洛拉的精度,从35.9%提高到46.6%,同时将平均模型路径时间从774.9秒减少到364.1秒;WeAct-hard在181.0秒时达到40.8%(图8)。 TIES-R64在多跳QA上的模型路径较短,但在所有8个基准上的精度都低于WeAct两个变体.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Accuracy versus model-path time on General and Multi-hop QA. Points pair Table 1 accuracy with historical mean cumulative time, including retries. Colors and markers identify methods; line styles group benchmarks. Time axes are logarithmic in seconds.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Historical task-record wall-clock distributions. Colors and markers identify methods; line styles identify benchmarks. Each panel uses its own logarithmic time axis in seconds and retains all tails. Curves include all valid task-record times and saved retries, regardless of correctness; logged wall time can include post-answer judging.

blocks.en: Typical cost and long tails. Both WeAct variants have lower mean task-record wall time than Full SFT on all eight benchmarks and lower means than Single LoRA on six and seven benchmarks for soft and hard, respectively. ReAct and TIES-R64 often have shorter typical runs, but WeAct has much shorter tails (Figure 9 ). On GAIA, their medians are lower than both WeAct variants’, yet WeAct -hard’s 99th percentile is below those of all four baselines.
blocks.zh: 典型的成本和长尾巴. 在所有8项基准中,WeAct两个变体的平均任务记录墙壁时间都低于Full SFT,在软和硬的6和7项基准中,其手段也低于Single LoRA。 ReAct和TIES-R64的典型运行时间往往较短,但WeAct的尾巴要短得多(图9). 在GAIA上,它们的中位数低于WeAct两个变体的中位数,然而WeAct-hard的第99百分位数则低于所有四个基线的中位数.

blocks.en: On Multi-hop QA, ReAct and TIES-R64 also have shorter typical runs, while WeAct is more accurate than both and uses less mean wall time than Full SFT and Single LoRA. The largest tails occur on Search: on WebWalkerQA, WeAct -hard’s 99th percentile is 1,092 seconds versus ReAct’s 25,315 seconds, despite a longer median. XBench-DS shows the same contrast, although Single LoRA has a lower mean than WeAct -hard at lower accuracy. On the seven benchmarks with ManuSearch logs, both WeAct variants have lower mean and median wall time than ManuSearch. Thus the mean-time gains coexist with longer typical runs than some baselines and substantially shorter extreme runs.
blocks.zh: 在Multi-hop QA上,ReAct和TIES-R64的典型运行时间也较短,而WeAct则比两者都更准确,使用比Full SFT和Single LoRA更低的平均值壁时间. 最大尾巴出现在Search上:在WebWalkerQA, WeAct - Hard的99百分位数是1,092秒对ReAct的25,315秒,尽管中位数更长. X Bench-DS显示的对比度相同,尽管Single LoRA的平均值低于WeAct-hard的精确度较低. 在有ManuSearch日志的7个基准上,WeAct两个变体的平均和中位壁时间都低于ManuSearch. 因此,平均时间收益与比某些基线更长的典型周期和大大缩短的极端周期共存。

blocks.en: Retries and first-run performance. Table 6 reports the share of tasks with saved retries on GAIA, 2Wiki, and WebWalkerQA. WeAct -soft retries more tasks than WeAct -hard, particularly on WebWalkerQA. WeAct -hard retries fewer tasks than the three trained baselines, and its accuracy changes by at most 0.15 percentage points from first to final run. By comparison, Single LoRA’s GAIA accuracy rises from 28.2% to 35.9%.

blocks.en: For WeAct -hard, the model-path time advantage over Single LoRA is already present in first runs on GAIA and 2Wiki. On WebWalkerQA, WeAct -hard uses 0.94 × \times Single LoRA’s first-run time, compared with 0.65 × \times when retries are included, so most of that gap comes from retries. The logs do not identify the cause of each retry.
blocks.zh: 对于WeAct -hard,在GAIA和2Wiki上已经出现了模型-路径时间优于Single LoRA的优势. 在WebWalkerQA上, WeAct -hard 使用0.94×\times LORA的首发时间是0.65×\x, 日志无法识别每次重试的原因 。

blocks.en: B.3 Runtime Decomposition and Cache Costs
blocks.zh: B.3 运行时间分解和缓存费用

blocks.en: We evaluate Full SFT, Single LoRA, WeAct -hard, and WeAct -soft on the same prespecified WebWalkerQA tasks, with 50 runs per method on the same hardware at task concurrency one. All runs are included regardless of correctness. Answer-ready time spans the complete root-agent execution, excluding subsequent judging. We partition this interval into mutually exclusive model, external-tool, adapter-control, observed cache, answer-extraction, and setup/orchestration intervals; their sum equals the root duration for every run. Model time is further separated by the active adapter or base route. Identified cache intervals, covering the observed cache flush and post-switch prefill, are moved out of their enclosing model calls so that no time is counted twice.
blocks.zh: 我们在同一预先指定的WebWalkerQA任务上评价了Full SFT、Single LORA、WeAct-hard和WeAct-soft,任务货币一上同一硬件上每个方法运行50次。 无论正确与否,所有运行都包括在内。 答复准备时间跨越完全的根剂执行,不包括随后的判断. 我们把这个间隔分成相互排斥的模型,外部工具,适配器控制,观察到的缓存,解答-提取,以及设置/操作间隔;它们的总和等于每次运行的根持续时间. 模型时间由活动适配器或基线进一步分离. 已确认的缓存间隔,包括所观察到的缓存冲和后切换预填,被移出其所附的模型调用,以便不计算两次时间。

blocks.en: Colors show the mean composition within each stage, not a single run’s event order. For WeAct -hard, the stages are Plan, Search, and a final Writing or Base stage. For WeAct -soft, Plan spans its load–offload interval, Search runs from the Plan offload to the Writing load (or to the end when Writing is absent), and Writing covers the remainder; these stages include Base calls and tools and average 16.2, 100.0, and 42.5 seconds, respectively. Terminal extraction, the startup Base interval, and Base-only execution are shown separately.
blocks.zh: 颜色显示每个阶段的平均构成,而不是一个运行的事件顺序。 对于 WeAct - 硬,阶段是计划,搜索,以及最终写作或基础阶段. 对于 WeAct -soft, 计划跨越负载-卸载间隔, 搜索从计划卸载到写载( 或在写作缺席时结束), 写作覆盖其余部分; 这些阶段包括 Base 呼叫和工具, 平均分别为 16. 2, 100. 0 和 42.5 秒 。 终端提取,启动基间隔,和仅Base执行分别显示.

blocks.en: Figure 10 shows that WeAct -soft’s mean latency is close to Single LoRA’s, while both WeAct variants use less time than Full SFT. Adapter control and observed cache intervals together occupy 8.2% of soft’s time and 2.8% of hard’s. Time is attributed to the model that served each request, so base-model and external-tool time within a Search stage is not counted as Search-adapter time.

External tools account for 85.6% of its mean answer-ready time and model calls for 14.2%; extraction or summarization performed inside a tool counts as tool time. blocks.en: Appendix C Sequential Capability Retention
blocks.zh: 附录C 能力保留

blocks.en: Adapter organizations. All four organizations start from frozen Qwen3-32B with identical initial weights. The shared baselines train one LoRA of rank 32 or 96, and the partitioned libraries train three rank-32 adapters. The capability partition gives each capability its own adapter in every trajectory. The random partition draws a fixed capability-to-adapter permutation for each trajectory, balanced across trajectories and kept for training and evaluation, so every adapter receives data from all three capabilities. A uniform rank isolates how parameters are organized; the main library uses capability-specific ranks (Section 4.1 ).

blocks.en: Data. We use 384 training and 192 validation trajectories, partitioning the latter into 168 for stage-end evaluation and 24 for monitoring. For each trajectory and capability, a fixed hash selects one complete assistant message as the target. The message is split into chunks of at most 512 target tokens, each with up to 7,168 preceding tokens of context; longer contexts keep the initial and most recent tokens around an omission marker. Each chunk with its context forms one training window.

blocks.en: Optimization. LoRA is applied to all attention and feed-forward projections with α = r \alpha=r and no dropout. Trainable parameters and optimizer moments are kept in FP32 over the BF16 backbone. Each order runs 288 updates, 96 per stage, with six windows per update; all organizations and orders consume the same window streams. We use AdamW without weight decay or gradient clipping, a linear warmup over the first 16 updates to 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , and a constant rate afterwards. Optimizer state persists across stages, and adapters inactive in a stage receive no updates. All 24 runs (four organizations by six orders) use one training seed, so the six orders are experimental conditions rather than replicates.

blocks.en: Capability adapters. The capability adapters use ranks 32, 64, and 32 for Plan, Search, and Writing, with α k = 32 \alpha_{k}=32 and no LoRA dropout. Search uses rank 64 because rank-32 pilots showed repetitive, non-terminating reasoning and unreliable external-tool and offload_lora calls. Each adapter places low-rank factors on the query, key, value, and output projections and on the gate, up, and down projections of all 64 transformer layers, and on the output projection ( lm_head ); input embeddings are not adapted. We train the adapters with Tinker ( Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) using the Qwen3 chat template, a batch size of eight, and a maximum sequence length of 32k. Adam uses ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0.9 , 0.95 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0.9,0.95) and ϵ = 10 − 8 \epsilon=10^{-8} , and the learning rate decays from its peak to zero on a cosine schedule without warmup. Plan trains for two epochs at a peak learning rate of 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} ; Search and Writing train for three epochs at 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} and 2 × 10 − 4 2\times 10^{-4} , respectively. Each capability’s data are shuffled with seed 42, and the first 200 records form a validation set for NLL monitoring. The activation and NLL diagnostics draw their evaluation records from these validation sets (Appendix E ). Samples for different modules can share source trajectories and execution prefixes, but not loss targets. Single LoRA follows the same recipe with rank 128, three epochs, and a peak learning rate of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} .

blocks.en: Evaluation protocol. The main table reports each benchmark separately, and its Avg. column is the unweighted mean over the eight benchmarks. Each method keeps its own context management and model-call structure and attempts every task once. A task that ends without a valid boxed answer is retried up to twice, allowing at most three attempts; the first valid answer is scored. On 2Wiki, Bamboogle, and MuSiQue, an answer is correct if the boxed answer exactly matches the gold answer or one of its aliases after normalization (lowercasing and removing punctuation, articles, and extra whitespace). On the other five benchmarks, GPT-5.6 Luna compares the answer with the reference using each benchmark’s grading prompt; on GAIA, WebWalkerQA, and FRAMES, answers that match the reference after normalization are accepted without a judge call. blocks.en: Insertion adds a code capability without retraining the base, modifying the plan , search , and writing adapters, or replaying their data. We train only a new code adapter on code-computation trajectories from MiroVerse-MegaScience, converted to our tool and handoff protocol; these trajectories use code to calculate and verify answers from given conditions. Registering the code alias extends the routing vocabulary from K = 3 K=3 to K = 4 K=4 .
blocks.zh: 插入会增加一个代码能力,而无需再培训基础,修改计划,搜索,并写入适配器,或者重放数据. 我们只从MiroVerse-MegaScience培训一个新的代码适配器,转换成我们的工具和交接协议;这些轨道使用代码来计算和验证特定条件下的答案. 注册代码别名将路由词汇从K=3K=3扩展至K=4K=4.

blocks.en: The evaluation has two parts. First, we compare hashes of the base and the three existing adapters before and after insertion. Second, as shown in Table 9 , we evaluate the original GAIA tasks before and after insertion, reporting the paired quality change and how often code is invoked on tasks that need no computation (2 of 80). New-capability utility is measured on MegaScience ( Fan et al., 2026 ) , SciBench ( Wang et al., 2024a ) , and DS-1000 ( Lai et al., 2023 ) . Insertion succeeds only if code tasks improve, the existing hashes are unchanged, old-task quality does not decrease, and misrouting into code stays low; unchanged parameters alone do not suffice.
blocks.zh: 评价分为两部分。 首先,我们在插入前后比较基座和三个现有适配器的散列. 第二,如表9所示,我们评价插入前后最初的GAIA任务,报告配对的质量变化,以及在不需要计算的任务上使用代码的次数(80次中的2次)。 新的能力效用在MegaScience(Fan等人,2026年),SciBench(Wang等人,2024年a)和DS-1000(Lai等人,2023年)上测量。 只有在代码任务改进,现有散列不变,旧任务质量不下降,错误的输入代码时才会成功;单是不变参数是不够的.
